UML:TaggedValue.value: [Source requirement] The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's requirements; otherwise, the water temperature may not be controlled within the appropriate range.

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.1 High Temperature Cooling Water Setpoint

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 79°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 77-85°C. Criterion: 79°C nominal; mechanical thermostatic element range 77-85°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Check Cited: E-LT-COMP-006

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.2 Low Temperature Cooling Water Setpoint

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The low-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 35°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 29-41°C. Criterion: 35°C nominal; mechanical thermostatic element range 29-41°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Check Cited: E-LT-COMP-006

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.3 Lubricating Oil Inlet Temperature Setpoi

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The lubricating oil inlet temperature setpoint shall be 66°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 63-72°C. Criterion: 66°C nominal; mechanical thermostatic element range 63-72°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Check Cited: E-LT-COMP-006

The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The three-way valve shall be installed as a mixing valve, and its design pressure drop shall be 0.3-0.6 bar. Criterion: 0.3-0.6 bar Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Check Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-047

The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The pipe length between the temperature sensor installation position and the three-way valve shall be maintained at 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter. Criterion: 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter Grade: C Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Check Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-047

The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature shall be controlled between 90 and 100°C. The electronic water temperature controller shall identify the deviation via the engine outlet sensor and correct the reference value. Criterion: 90-100°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Check Cited: E-SYS-COMP-006

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.7 External Controller for Shared Cooling S

UML:TaggedValue.value: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When multiple engines share a combined low-temperature cooling water system, an external temperature controller shall be used. The external controller shall be installed on the engine control room console and wired to the temperature control valve. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:none|ref:S41 Everllence 49/60DF Project Guide|component:low-temperature cooling water temperature control valve|intent:installation position|hint:external temperature controller installed on engine control room console and wired to temperature control valve}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Check Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-055

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.8 Common Low Temperature Control Valve

UML:TaggedValue.value: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When engine-driven low-temperature pumps are used to cool external equipment, a common low- temperature temperature control valve shall be provided in the external system. The common low- temperature temperature control valve shall be installed after the central cooler and shall control the water temperature upstream of the engine and external equipment by partially bypassing the central cooler. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:none|ref:S28 Wärtsilä 32 Product Guide, Cooling Water System|component:common low- temperature temperature control valve|intent:installation position|hint:common low- temperature temperature control valve installed after central cooler, controls water temperature upstream of engine and external equipment by partially bypassing central cooler}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Check Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-062

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.9 Auxiliary Engine Outlet Temperature Sett

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C. Criterion: 80°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Check Cited: E-LT-PRESS-003; E-LT-PRESS-005

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.10 Auxiliary Engine Outlet Temperature Sett

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C. Criterion: 80°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Check Cited: E-HT-COMP-004

The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve shall be verified against the main engine manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents. The parameter confirmation path shall follow the minimum temperature control method for cooling system thermostatic control (inlet control or outlet control). The maximum temperature shall be controlled by correct sizing of the radiator, heat exchanger, or similar equipment. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:none|ref:S21 Caterpillar Cooling Systems Application and Installation Guide|component:temperature control valve|intent:setpoint and installation position confirmation path|hint:determined per main engine manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents, distinguishing inlet control from outlet control methods}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Analyze Cited: E-SYS-PRESS-006
